Privacy Policy

Last Updated: July 5, 2026

At Verity, we believe your financial records are your private property. We have built this platform with a "privacy-first" architecture, meaning we minimize what we know about your files and maximize your control over them.

1. Data We Collect

We collect only the information necessary to provide our service:

  • Account Information: We exclusively support secure, passwordless authentication and social logins via Google and GitHub. We only collect basic profile details (email and name) to manage your account. This itself removes the most common point of vulnerability and phishing.
  • Usage Data: We use a minimal essential cookie to manage your local timezone setting so your records display correctly, and pseudonymous analytics only when you opt in. See Section 2 for details.
  • Technical Logs: Basic server logs to maintain the security and integrity of our systems.
  • Document Metadata: We store metadata (filename, timestamp) to help you organize and retrieve your records.

2. Cookies and Analytics

We use a small number of cookies. We never sell data, and analytics run only if you accept them.

  • Essential cookie — timezone (user_timezone): Stored in your browser to remember your local timezone so dates and records are accurate. This cookie is strictly necessary, does not identify you, is not shared with anyone, and expires after one year.
  • Analytics (PostHog): Analytics are off by default. If you click "Accept All," we enable PostHog to understand aggregate usage (page views, feature usage, performance) so we can improve Verity. PostHog runs on our own infrastructure and sets first-party cookies such as __posthog_<project_token> and ph_<project_token>_posthog. It does not use your document contents, and we do not use it to build advertising profiles or share data with advertisers.
  • Optional (declined): If you click "Decline" or take no action, analytics remain disabled and no analytics cookies are set. Essential cookies only are used.
  • Managing your choice: Your consent choice is stored locally in your browser's storage. You can change it at any time by clearing this site's cookies and site data in your browser settings.

3. How We Handle Your Files & AI Processing

We use Cloudflare R2 for secure storage and the Gemini API for intelligent organization. Our security standards include:

  • Direct, Secure Uploads: Files are uploaded directly from your device to storage using time-limited, signed URLs (30-minute lifespan).
  • AI-Powered Insights: We transmit specific document content to the Gemini API solely to extract information (dates, amounts, categories) to populate your records.
  • Data Retention: Our Gemini API processing is configured to retain document data only for the duration necessary to complete the extraction. Verity does not use Gemini's service to train Google's machine learning models.
  • Private Ownership: Your files and extracted data are linked exclusively to your unique user ID.

4. Sharing and Disclosure

We do not sell, rent, or trade your information. Data is shared only if required by law or with our core infrastructure providers (Cloudflare, Google/Gemini, and our hosting provider) to deliver our services.

5. Data Retention and Deletion

  • Retention: We retain your account information and document metadata as long as your account remains active.
  • Permanent Deletion: You have the right to delete your records at any time. When triggered, your files are permanently scrubbed from our Cloudflare R2 storage and our primary database.
  • Archives: Archives serve as a "soft delete" feature, allowing you to restore records while helping us maintain accurate, clean statistics for your dashboard.

6. Your Rights

  • Right to be Forgotten: Upon closing your account, all associated personal data, metadata, and uploaded files are permanently and securely deleted from our systems.

7. Contact Us

If you have questions about how we handle your data, reach out to our privacy team at: support@veritypay.app
